page0.text:
I'm going to get away from this place.
Saber can't win against that monster.
If I let her keep fighting, she's dead.
Then...
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-06:page0:1

page1.text:
"Tohsaka, this way!"
"Gh—!?"
I take Tohsaka's hand and run.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-06:page1:1

page2.text:
If that girl is really after us, she'll definitely give chase.
That means Saber might live, and we might have a chance to survive if we can get somewhere there are people.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-06:page2:1

page3.text:
"Wait! We can't just turn our backs on him!"
"What?"
She shakes me off.
And then there's a flash.
Tohsaka moves in to protect my defenseless back.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-06:page3:1

page4.text:
"Ha...gch."
She takes the blow that had been meant for me.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-06:page4:1

page5.text:
"Toh...sa..."
She turns her face towards me, and I see her pained expression.
Cough.
Red stains her lips, and she looks down almost curiously at the sword impaling her chest.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-06:page5:1

page6.text:
"Huh... What the hell was I think...ing...?"
Is that a question about her trying to protect me? Or just taking Berserker's attack?
Tohsaka tilts her head, admitting that it had all been useless from the start.
"The church. Go to...Kirei..."
Almost the instant she's spoken those words, Berserker hurls her body to the ground.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-06:page6:1

page7.text:
"Ah..."
My body reacts before I can think.
The dark giant looms before me.
As the monster throws Tohsaka's body to the ground, I seize the opportunity to run away.
"AAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!"
I flee desperately, like an animal jumping through a ring of fire.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-06:page7:1

page8.text: "Oooh, he's running away. Brother is so cute, thinking he can run away from Berserker."
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-06:page8:1

page9.text:
I run.
Tohsaka's words echo in my head.
The church. I need to run up the hill and reach the church.
I'll go to the church and ask Kotomine for help.
I need to do that.
Or else Tohsaka will die.
And Saber will die.
I won't be able to help either of them, and I'll die too!
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-06:page9:1

page10.text:
I feel a blow to my back.
But it's not a sword.
The giant's dozer blade hands strike my back, sending me flying.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-06:page10:1

page11.text:
Ah...
"You knucklehead! I told you not to kill him quickly! Can you not even do something as simple as that!? You useless brute! If you disobey my orders again, I'll keep killing you until you're only left with your very last life!"
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-06:page11:1

page12.text:
Gah...arg...
"Huh? He's alive? You threw him all that way, and he's still alive?"
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-06:page12:1

page13.text:
I...
"So. You're alive, brother. You may not be able to use any magecraft, but I guess there was a reason you were chosen as a Master.
Fine. If you're not going to put up a fight like this, then there was no point in me coming to Japan."
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-06:page13:1

page14.text:
"H-hrrk...ghhn..."
I can't move.
Calling the state I'm in "alive" would be sort of an overstatement.
"Goner" would be closer to the mark.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-06:page14:1

page15.text: "Nope. I'm not going to let you die that easily. I need to hurt you more, and teach you how wonderful your life was up until this point."
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-06:page15:1

page16.text:
The silver-haired girl holds my head down.
Cold, pale fingertips freeze my skull.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-06:page16:1

page17.text: I know somehow that I can't possibly go back to who I was before...
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-06:page17:1

page18.text: "Fufu. I'm going to turn you into an ugly doll that won't be able to die. You're going to take Kiritsugu's place from now on."
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-06:page18:1

page19.text: I muster the last bit of sense I have to hope Saber and Tohsaka are safe.
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-06:page19:1
